title: 수산업협동조합의 부실예방 및 구조개선에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
title_original: 수산업협동조합의 부실예방 및 구조개선에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 4 (Financial Condition Criteria for Potentially Unsound Cooperatives) Under Article 2, paragraph 4 of the Act, "a cooperative that is likely to become unsound due to its financial condition falling below the standards specified in a Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries ordinance" refers to a cooperative that meets any of the following:

1. A cooperative with a net capital ratio of less than 20% of total assets.
2. A cooperative with a comprehensive evaluation grade of 4 or less, or a cooperative with a comprehensive evaluation grade of 3 or higher, or a comprehensive evaluation grade of 4 or less in the capital adequacy or asset soundness section.
3. A cooperative where it is clear that it will fall under items 1 or 2 due to the occurrence of a financial crisis or non-performing assets.
